title_en: 22 The Greedy Ghost Hanging from the Moon
full_text_zh:
[P1] 吊在月亮下的贪心鬼
diao zai yue liang xia de tan xin gui

[P2] 贪心鬼长得矮矮胖胖的。他有一颗贪得无厌的心。
贪心鬼每天晚上坐在窗前，看着月亮从山坡后面升起，慢慢升向天空。月亮洒下银白色的光，把山坡照亮，把森林照亮，也把贪心鬼的小屋照亮。
照亮。
贪心鬼想，要是我能织一张很大的网，把月亮网住，就能把月亮拖回家来。当月亮亮着的时候，我可以把

[P3] 她当灯点；当月亮圆着的时候，我可以把她当盘子，也许，月亮还是银子做的，那就可以把她拿到市场上去换钱……
至于天空中没了月亮怎么办，贪心鬼是不管的。
贪心鬼整天躲在家里织网，他不停地织呀织呀，他希望自己的网织得越大越好。
贪心鬼的网织好了。
他拿着这张大网，爬上小山坡，他想等月亮从山上一露头，就使劲把网撒出去，这样准能网到月亮。

[P4] 月亮一点也不知道贪心鬼的坏主意，她还是慢慢地升上山坡。贪心鬼看准了时机，“嘿”的一声撒出了网，月亮就被网住了。
可是贪心鬼不知道，月亮是个劲儿很大的姑娘，她根本不害怕，还是慢慢地往上升，往上升，越升越高。
贪心鬼使劲地拽住网绳，他本想把月亮拖回家的，谁知道反而被月亮拽上了天空。

[P5] 贪心鬼吊在网绳上，越升越高，
越升越高……
这一天，人们觉得奇怪，怎么月亮
没有往常明亮？
大家抬头一看，吃了一惊。原来
有个叫贪心鬼的家伙，想用网网走
月亮。人们指责贪心鬼，人们咒骂贪
心鬼，人们嘲笑贪心鬼。还有人按捺
不住满腔的怒火，举起长竹竿，想打
这个贪心鬼的屁股。
贪心鬼吓得哇哇大叫。

[P6] 半个地球上的人 都看到了贪心鬼的狼狈相。不少人还举起照相机，拍下了贪心鬼的丑相。幸好，贪心鬼的劲儿也不小，他使劲拽住网绳，一刻也不松手。
等到天快亮时，月亮慢慢朝西边降落，贪心鬼看准时机，赶快跳下山坡逃走了。这时，太阳升起来了。
贪心鬼知道，他吊在月亮下的照片，肯定登上了今天报纸的头版头条，他再也不敢见人了。
于是，贪心鬼钻进了一个没有太阳、没有月亮的山洞。
不过，只要他一露面，人们还是会认出他来的。
full_text_en:
[P1] The Greedy Ghost Hanging Under the Moon
diao zai yue liang xia de tan xin gui

[P2] The greedy ghost is short and fat. He has a heart that is greedy without limit.
The greedy ghost sits by the window every evening, watching the moon rise from behind the hill, slowly ascending into the sky. The moon sheds silver-white light, illuminating the hillside, the forest, and also the greedy ghost's little house.
Illuminated.
The greedy ghost thinks, if I could weave a very big net, catch the moon in it, I could drag the moon home. When the moon is shining, I could take...

[P3] She can be a lamp; when the moon is round, I can use her as a plate. Maybe the moon is made of silver, then I can take her to the market to exchange for money...
As for what to do if the moon disappears from the sky, the greedy ghost doesn't care.
The greedy ghost spends all day hiding at home weaving a net. He weaves and weaves, hoping his net will become bigger and better.
The greedy ghost's net is finished.
He takes this big net, climbs up the small hill, and plans to throw it out the moment the moon peeks over the mountain. That way, he's sure to catch the moon.

[P4] The moon didn't know about the greedy ghost's bad idea; she still slowly rose up the hill. The greedy ghost spotted the right moment, "Hey!" he shouted, and cast his net — the moon was caught.
But the greedy ghost didn't know that the moon was a girl with great strength. She wasn't afraid at all, and continued to rise slowly, higher and higher.
The greedy ghost pulled hard on the net rope. He had wanted to drag the moon home, but instead, he was pulled up into the sky by the moon.

[P5] The greedy ghost hung on the net rope, rising higher and higher,
rising higher and higher...
One day, people felt strange. Why wasn't the moon
as bright as usual?
Everyone looked up and was shocked. It turned out
there was a fellow called Greedy Ghost, who wanted to catch the moon with a net.
People blamed Greedy Ghost, cursed Greedy Ghost,
laughed at Greedy Ghost. Some even couldn't hold back their anger, raised long bamboo poles, and wanted to hit
this Greedy Ghost's bottom.
Greedy Ghost screamed in fear.

[P6] Half the people on Earth saw the greedy ghost's disgraceful appearance. Many even raised their cameras to take pictures of his shameful look. Fortunately, the greedy ghost was also quite strong, and he pulled hard on the net rope, not letting go for a single moment.
When the sky was about to brighten, the moon slowly descended toward the west. The greedy ghost seized the opportunity and quickly jumped down the hillside to escape. At that moment, the sun rose.
The greedy ghost knew that the photo of him hanging under the moon would surely make the front page of today's newspaper. He dared not face anyone anymore.
So, the greedy ghost crawled into a cave with no sun and no moon.
However, as soon as he showed his face, people would still recognize him.
full_summary_zh:
[P1] 本页为绘本标题页，竖排文字显示书名《吊在月亮下的贪心鬼》，并附有拼音注释。
[P2] 本页描绘了贪心鬼在夜晚坐在窗前，看着月亮升起并照亮周围环境的场景，同时内心想着如何用网把月亮拖回家。
[P3] 本页描绘了贪心鬼在家中织网，并计划用网捕捉月亮的场景。他幻想月亮可以当灯、盘子或银子换钱，完全不顾月亮消失后的后果，最终织好大网，准备在月亮升起时将其网住。
[P4] 贪心鬼用网捕捉月亮，但月亮力量巨大，反而将贪心鬼拽上了天空。
[P5] 贪心鬼被月亮拽上天空后，人们发现月亮不再明亮，纷纷指责、嘲笑他，甚至有人想用竹竿打他，贪心鬼吓得大叫。
[P6] 贪心鬼在月亮即将落下时成功逃脱，但因被拍下狼狈相而不敢见人，躲进一个没有太阳和月亮的山洞，却仍担心被人认出。
[P7] 本页画面中，贪心鬼惊慌地奔跑，双手张开，身后扬起一小团尘土，似乎正从某个地方仓皇逃出，表情惊恐，暗示他刚刚经历了一场惊险的逃脱。
